title: Carbon Pricing and Inflation Expectations
abstract: Putting a price on carbon emissions helps mitigate climate change but may also raise overall price inflation. Using high-frequency event studies based on regulatory news in the European carbon market, we show that carbon price surprises generate significant increases not only in energy futures prices, but also in inflation swap rates and break-even inflation rates. These measures of inflation compensation respond positively at both short and long horizons, with significant effects up to ten years out. Such persistent effects of climate policy on market-based inflation expectations are relevant for central banks. However, despite the sustained effects on inflation compensation, forward-looking nominal interest rates show no meaningful response to the carbon policy shocks, suggesting that investors do not anticipate that the European Central Bank will lean against the inflationary effects of higher carbon prices.
abstract_zh: 为碳排放定价有助于缓解气候变化，但也可能推高总体物价水平。利用基于欧洲碳市场监管新闻的高频事件研究，我们表明，碳价意外变动不仅会显著推高能源期货价格，还会推高通胀互换利率和盈亏平衡通胀率。这些通胀补偿指标在短期和长期视野下均呈正向反应，且效应可持续至十年后。气候政策对市场化通胀预期的这种持续影响，与各国央行密切相关。然而，尽管通胀补偿受到持续影响，前瞻性名义利率对碳政策冲击并无显著反应，这表明投资者并不预期欧洲央行会对抗碳价上涨带来的通胀效应。

title: Corporate Green Pledges
abstract: We build a novel data set of time-stamped corporate decarbonization commitments—green pledges—for U.S. public firms by classifying news articles with large language models and human validation. Firms announcing green pledges tend to be larger and browner than other firms, both within and across industries. Green pledges significantly raise stock prices, consistent with a reduction in the carbon premium, and predict sizable declines in future carbon emissions and emission intensities. These effects tend to be strongest for firms in brown industries. Green pledges thus appear credible, convey relevant new information to investors, and provide meaningful financial incentives to decarbonize.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个新颖的数据集，记录了美国上市公司带有时间戳的脱碳承诺——即“绿色承诺”（green pledges）。该数据集通过利用大型语言模型对新闻文章进行分类，并经人工核验而得到。宣布绿色承诺的企业往往比其他企业规模更大、也更“棕色”（即高碳），无论是在行业内还是跨行业比较中皆是如此。绿色承诺显著推高了股价，这与碳溢价的降低相一致，并且能够预测未来碳排放量及排放强度的大幅下降。这些效应在棕色行业的企业中往往最为显著。因此，绿色承诺似乎是可信的，向投资者传递了相关的新信息，并为脱碳提供了有意义的经济激励。

The Effect of U.S. Climate Policy on Financial Markets: An Event Study of the Inflation Reduction Act
abstract: The Inflation Reduction Act of 2022 (IRA) represents the largest climate policy action ever undertaken in the United States. Its legislative path was marked by two abrupt shifts as the likelihood of climate policy action fell to near zero and then rose to near certainty. We investigate equity price reactions to these two events, which represent major realizations of climate policy transition risk. Our results highlight the heterogeneous nature of climate policy risk exposure. We find sizable reactions that differ by industry as well as across firm-level measures of greenness such as environmental scores and emission intensities. While the financial market response to the IRA was economically significant, it did not lead to instability or financial stress, suggesting that transition risks posed by climate policies even as ambitious as the IRA may be manageable.
abstract_zh: 《2022年通胀削减法案》（IRA）代表了美国历史上规模最大的一项气候政策行动。其立法过程经历了两次突然转折：气候政策行动的可能性先是降至接近于零，随后又升至接近确定。我们考察了股票价格对这两个事件的反应，它们代表了气候政策转型风险的两次重大实现。我们的结果凸显了气候政策风险敞口的异质性。我们发现，不同行业以及以环境评分和排放强度等企业层面绿色度指标衡量的企业之间，股价反应存在较大差异。尽管金融市场对IRA的反应在经济上是显著的，但并未导致不稳定或金融压力，这表明即使像IRA这样雄心勃勃的气候政策所带来的转型风险，也可能是可以管理的。

The Rising Cost of Climate Change: Evidence from the Bond Market
abstract: Social discount rates (SDRs) are crucial for evaluating the costs of climate change. We show that the fundamental anchor for market-based SDRs is the equilibrium or steady-state real interest rate. Empirical interest rate models that allow for shifts in this equilibrium real rate find that it has declined notably since the 1990s, and this decline implies that the entire term structure of SDRs has shifted lower as well. Accounting for this new normal of persistently lower interest rates substantially boosts estimates of the social cost of carbon and supports a climate policy with stronger carbon mitigation strategies.
abstract_zh: 社会贴现率（SDR）对于评估气候变化的成本至关重要。我们表明，基于市场的社会贴现率的基本锚定是均衡或稳态实际利率。允许均衡实际利率发生变化的实证利率模型发现，自1990年代以来，该利率已显著下降，而这一下降意味着整个社会贴现率期限结构也随之下移。考虑到这种利率持续走低的“新常态”，会大幅提高碳的社会成本估计，并支持采取减排力度更大的气候政策。

title: Market-Based Monetary Policy Uncertainty
Where is the Carbon Premium? Global Performance of Green and Brown Stocks
abstract: The relative equity pricing of more climate-friendly (“green”) versus less climate-friendly  (“brown”) companies is an open question in climate finance. Previous research comes to conflicting conclusions, documenting either a “carbon premium” with brown stocks yielding higher returns, or the opposite, with green stocks outperforming brown. This paper provides new international evidence on this issue for a range of methodologies. Using carbon dioxide (CO2) emissions as reported by companies to measure their greenness, we document that green stocks across the G7 have generally provided higher returns than brown stocks for much of the past decade. We also try to reconcile our findings with previous work, and we provide some results for early 2022 that show that brown stocks outperformed green ones during the energy crisis.
abstract_zh: 在气候金融中，对气候更友好的“绿色”公司与气候友好度较低的“棕色”公司之间的相对股权定价，是一个悬而未决的问题。以往研究得出了相互矛盾的结论：有的记录了“碳溢价”，即棕色股票收益更高；也有相反的结论，即绿色股票表现更优。本文就这一问题为各种方法论提供了新的国际证据。利用企业报告的二氧化碳（CO2）排放量来衡量其绿色程度，我们发现，在过去十年的大部分时间里，G7国家的绿色股票总体上提供了高于棕色股票的收益。我们还尝试协调本研究结果与以往研究，并提供了2022年初的一些结果，表明在能源危机期间棕色股票的表现优于绿色股票。
